description: Language-neutral backend acceptance scenarios from docs/22, 25 and 26. A runner must drive real services with controlled model/tool/store dependencies, record observations and assert these outcomes; merely parsing this file or echoing fixtures is not a pass. No TS backend execution is claimed.
observationRules: Collect accepted/rejected responses, emitted RunEvent values, snapshots, model requests, tool dispatches and committed conversation state.
Validate all public values against manifest schemas. Compare concatenated text/reasoning and observable action/state order, not token chunk boundaries or internal SQL.
Use synchronization barriers for races, not sleeps. Owner comes from the trusted adapter, never RunRequest.
A normal connected accepted run has exactly one end event and no later event. Event-send failure may prevent end delivery, but must cancel work without replay.
Use synthetic credential sentinels only. Inspect errors, snapshots and captured diagnostics for leaks; feature text and explicitly allowed payload are not diagnostic logs.

given: No history store
Hold delivery of the accepted response after backend acceptance
Controlled model produces visible text and reasoning
when: Release model output before accepted-response delivery
expect: Events may precede the caller's accepted response, but never backend acceptance
Accepted conversationId and turnId are null
Text and reasoning each preserve observable order
Snapshot becomes completed
One completed end is last

given: Persisted conversation with a completed selected turn
Observe conversation rows, active registry and model dispatch count
when: Independently reject missing model configuration, stale pinned skill revision, unsupported vision input and unauthorized capability
expect: Each start returns KitError before acceptance
No active run, new half-turn or selection change remains
No model request or tool dispatch occurs
Existing turns and image rows remain unchanged

given: Completed source has input text, input images and endpoint/model identity
Host preparation records the effective input
when: Retry source while supplying unrelated client input
Repeat with source model unavailable and no explicit replacement
Try conflicting retry/translation/regenerate/replyTo combinations, source without conversationId and client images on source actions
expect: Host and model see the same authoritative source text/images, never unrelated client input
Missing source model returns source_model_unavailable before reservation
Explicit replacement changes model only
Conflicting actions reject with bad_request and leave no half-turn

given: Pinned tool catalog contains an Ask tool
Tool dispatch is observable
expect: tool_call precedes approval_required
Preview has at most 2000 Unicode characters
No dispatch before approval
Exactly one dispatch occurs
Duplicate approval returns conflict/not_found, never dispatches again
tool_result reflects actual result

given: Three independent runs paused at Ask approval
when: Cancel the second before tool dispatch
Let the third approval expire then approve late
expect: Denied tool has outcome denied and is not dispatched
Cancelled undispatched work never executes
Late approval returns conflict/not_found and never executes
Each run reaches at most one terminal state

given: One run with a counting tool and stable catalog
when: Reuse that callId with different arguments or tool name
expect: Identical request reuses the known result and dispatch count stays one
Conflicting reuse is rejected
A new run does not inherit this run-local deduplication guarantee

given: Side-effecting tool acknowledges dispatch but its result becomes unobservable
when: Cancel or break the tool transport after dispatch
Allow the engine to observe the uncertain result
expect: Tool outcome is unknown, not ordinary error or an invented successful result
Unknown is not an EndStatus
No automatic retry or side-effect replay occurs
Snapshot cancellation intent does not claim the effect was rolled back

given: First tool produces a confirmed error
Controlled model can consume the tool result and answer
expect: tool_result outcome is error
Actual result is fed back once
The run may finish completed; a tool error is not automatically a failed end

given: Controlled model repeatedly requests permitted tools until configured round limit
expect: End is completed with exhausted true
Snapshot has completed and exhausted true
No additional model round or tool dispatch occurs

given: Controlled upstream emits text and then a network failure
expect: Already visible text is preserved in order
Exactly one failed end carries safe KitError
Snapshot is failed and does not contain transcript or credentials

given: Persisted run completes model output
Hold finish_turn commit at a barrier
when: Inspect snapshot and event stream before releasing commit
expect: Snapshot stays running while saving
No completed end appears before commit
Committed turn and selection are visible before completed end
Snapshot then becomes completed

given: Persisted run completes model output
finish_turn deterministically fails
expect: Exactly one failed end, not completed
Snapshot is failed with safe persistence error
No false completed turn or selection is committed
No model/tool replay attempts to hide persistence failure

given: Run has a barrier-controlled dispatched side effect or pending save
when: Release barrier and race repeated cancellation with finalization
expect: Cancel returns Ack ok true
Before resolution snapshot remains running with cancelRequested true
Cancellation does not immediately invent cancelled or undo dispatched effects
Final terminal transition occurs at most once
Repeated terminal cancellation returns identical Ack

given: Owner A has a running approval and a completed run
Owner B and an unknown runId are available
when: B calls snapshot/approve/cancel on A's run
Compare with each operation on unknown runId
A approves its own pending request
expect: Snapshot and approve return not_found for both cross-owner and unknown IDs
Cancel returns Ack ok true for cross-owner, unknown and terminal IDs
Cross-owner cancellation does not affect A's work
Only A's approval may dispatch

given: Keep one long-running run active
Start terminal candidates in a different order from completion order
when: Restart the service and query a previous runId
expect: Only the latest 128 terminal completions remain queryable
The oldest completed candidate is not_found regardless of start order
The still-active run is not evicted
Restarted service returns not_found; durable history is queried separately

given: Model/tool stream is paused after one observable event
Event receiver can be closed deterministically
when: Allow next send and release remaining work
expect: Send failure requests cancellation of subsequent work
No tool side effect is replayed
Backend reaches at most one terminal state without requiring end network delivery

given: Credential/cause/SQL/header sentinels exist only in backend connection and error source
Stored reasoning includes visible text and native signatures
One input image reference is expired
expect: No credential, cause, stack, SQL or authentication header sentinel occurs in public error/snapshot/log
Internal errorId links to diagnostics without exposing cause
Turn exposes visible reasoningText, not native reasoning JSON/messages
Expired image remains as ImageRef with url null
Allowed payload is host-approved and budgeted, not arbitrary protocol forwarding

given: Prepare source text/images/model and history fingerprint
Pause before transactional reservation
when: Modify source, selection or purge source image bytes
expect: Reservation detects changed basis and returns conflict
No half-turn is committed
The model never receives an effective request different from the one host authorized

given: Conversation has completed branch A/B and a non-running source candidate
when: Delete a branch parent and fork a surviving branch
expect: Reply history contains only selected ancestry
Retry preserves source input/images/parent/question/kind and supersedes source without deleting it
Translation uses visible assistant text only, new question identity and no source images
Delete reattachment and fork preserve valid branch/image ownership per docs/26
Foreign/missing/cyclic references are never accepted as valid history

given: Host allows only a subset of permission modes and declares read/edit/exec/other tools
when: Request a mode not offered by this host
Try to lower a Deny using full_access or a tool's read-only hint
expect: Wire values are default/plan/accept_edits/auto/full_access
Unsupported host selection rejects before model dispatch
Plan does not expose non-read tools
Host authorization remains terminal
Full access never overrides Deny; MCP hints do not grant host authority
